instructions:
1. Sit on a preacher bench with feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
3. Rest your arms on the pad with elbows extended.
4. Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
5. Squeeze at the top, then lower the bar slowly until your arms are extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms stationary against the pad to isolate the biceps.
2. Use a weight that lets you control the full range.
3. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
4. Avoid swinging the torso.
name: Preacher curl ez bar

instructions:
1. Sit on a preacher bench with feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip, hands just inside shoulder-width.
3. Rest your arms on the pad with elbows extended.
4. Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
5. Squeeze at the top, then lower the bar slowly until your arms are extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your upper arms stationary against the pad to isolate the biceps.
2. The closer grip shifts emphasis toward the outer biceps and peak.
3. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
4. Lower under control through the full range.
name: Preacher curl ez bar close grip

instructions:
1. Sit on a preacher bench with feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip, hands just outside shoulder-width.
3. Rest your arms on the pad with elbows extended.
4. Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
5. Squeeze at the top, then lower the bar slowly until your arms are extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:

3. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
4. Keep wrists firm and neutral on the bar.
name: Preacher curl ez bar wide grip

instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with both legs extended in front of you.
2. Bend your right knee and place your right foot flat on the floor outside your left thigh.
3. Rotate your torso to the right and place your left elbow against the outside of your right knee.
4. Place your right hand on the floor behind you for support.
5. Hold, then release and switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move into the stretch slowly to avoid overstretching.
2. Use the rear hand for balance and to deepen the rotation.
3. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch.
4. Keep your spine tall rather than slouched.
name: Pretzel stretch

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to about 30 degrees and lie chest-down on it.
2. Hold a barbell below you with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight down.
3. Pull the barbell toward your upper abdomen, driving your elbows back and close to your body.
4. Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
5. Lower the barbell with control until your arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest pressed into the bench to remove momentum.
2. Lead with your elbows, not your hands, to target the back.
3. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your neck neutral and gaze down.
name: Prone bench row barbell pronate grip
